objective: Search a complete low-complexity family for a single mechanically defined structural column that carries the one scalar character missing from the DIRECT_SUM boundary carrier.
source: Each ZERO_VS_POSITIVE OOO triangle is projected to its depthless triangle motif M and boundary bit B=ANY_ZERO. For each of M's three pair records compute signed imbalances N_C, N_D0, N_D1 from depthless signed-parity counts.
symmetricCircuitBasis: For the three pair bits r1,r2,r3 use 1,e1,e2,e3 over GF(2), where e1=r1 xor r2 xor r3, e2=r1r2 xor r1r3 xor r2r3, e3=r1r2r3. Test all16 XOR combinations of these four basis functions.
candidateColumn: For each triangle occurrence, emit B * f(r1,r2,r3). A dependency column is the XOR over its frozen OOO triangle residue. Append exactly this one column to the frozen DIRECT_SUM carrier.
procedure: Prepare all 144 structural columns and augmented DIRECT_SUM rows before reading scalar codes.
Verify mask1/constant candidates reproduce the generic boundary-contact additive column when applicable.
Replay the pinned 462 scalar codes and report every exact candidate.
If multiple candidates pass, quotient them by equality of the realized 462-bit structural column before interpretation.
Do not select a winner by rank; every candidate adds at most one structural dimension.
guards: No motif ID lookup, geometry tag, state exception or scalar-selected marginal condition.
The family is permutation-invariant across the three triangle edges.
Numeric owner0/owner1 are source gauges; a passing owner-specific candidate remains representation-relative until mover-gauge transport is checked.
A pass is trained discovery only and does not qualify a closed formula or OOO generalization.
No sealed-holdout access or RS096 continuation.
